transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI launches study tools for teenage students, including a College Planner and revision cards, reported by Digital Watch Observatory.
Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 offers 75% lower costs and stronger smart agent capabilities for lightweight tasks. Reported by 智东西: Claude's strongest mini model debuts with prices plummeting 90 percent, rivaling DeepSeek.
Manus raises 500M and launches artificial intelligence app Cue after resuming independence from Meta. Confirmed by Yahoo Finance Singapore.
Anthropic adds Chinese-language support to Claude for overseas users, with UnionPay briefly shown as payment option. Reported by South China Morning Post: US artificial intelligence firm Anthropic enables Chinese-language options for Claude chatbot.
Reported by Bloomberg: Watch Google DeepMind's artificial intelligence Drug Spinoff, Isomorphic Labs, Seeks Funding at Valuation of 40 Billion.
